status: final prepared account-control source passed scoped connected checks; recovery decision and ordered publication remain open

checks.credentials: Real bcrypt and sockets: legacy short-password login, cross-account rejection, five-attempt shared budgets across fresh sockets, correct-password takeover, old-token invalidation, live-owner token not consumed, new registration, same-address independent account, closed-owner single-use resume and token rotation. Exact and uppercase configured bootstrap signup names are refused using real startup flags.
checks.administrator: Synthetic durable administrator and ordinary account: private admin JSON denied to ordinary players, owner-only report status, confirmed review and exact replay, private notes excluded from activity history, resume/disconnect history and single review receipt preserved after server restart. Login-only correction and appeal create no character and preserve independent restrictions.

threatReview.control: Existing bcrypt hash/compare, public-only bounded UTF-8 registration policy, whole-value local blocklist, per-client and shared account admission, bounded concurrent hash/query work.
threatReview.residual: Local blocklist is not a comprehensive breach corpus. Existing bcrypt byte ceiling is not a complete modern Unicode/password migration. Exact-case usernames are retained. Account-targeted temporary denial, distributed attacks and 100 simultaneous logins are not disproved.

threatReview.control: CSPRNG tokens bound to the authenticated transport, first-closure reconnect deadline, rotation and single consumer, live-owner refusal, retired-transport guards and character-work locking.
threatReview.residual: Tokens are bearer secrets; a stolen disconnected-owner token remains sensitive. Tokens are RAM-only and restart requires password login. The separate 15-minute dungeon rule is unchanged.

threatReview.control: Fresh durable role reads fail closed on unavailable storage; ordinary/retired/replaced/QA-only/allowlist-only clients cannot gain console authority. Durable confirmed operations and private receipts remain authoritative. Bootstrap is opt-in and reserved signup cannot acquire it.
threatReview.residual: An explicit old bootstrap allowlist must be removed after enrollment and during revocation. This check does not inspect private deployed configuration or prove every future admin action safe.

threatReview.control: Private authenticated account notices/appeals and owner-only report status. No password disclosure, arbitrary ownership grant, SMTP reset or unverified-email recovery endpoint added.
threatReview.residual: Owner must choose recovery delivery and ownership verification. Existing unverified email is not evidence of ownership. Milestone remains incomplete until the chosen safe recovery workflow is implemented and checked.

threatReview.control: Retain WebSocket origin policy, bounded inbound envelope/payload policies, trusted-role separation and existing operator controls.
threatReview.residual: Forwarded addresses remain logging-only, not credential authority. Suspicious-log cardinality/escaping, broader protocol/dependency review and hosting/address-family readiness belong to the next planned security/operations work; not certified here.
